coupler.summary: Each input illuminates a separate access guide. Select an input and a wavelength to inspect every output, including reflection.
coupler.limits: Fundamental quasi-TE mode at each port. Radiation and higher modes are excluded from the reported guided power sum. Material-grid differences affect weak reflection, phase and arm symmetry.

comparisons.description: The published SOI coupling length is 12.8827 µm for a 50 nm gap. Our measured four-port circuit uses a 125 nm central gap and curved access guides.
Compare straight-section supermodes separately from the complete bent circuit. Matched local Tidy3D mode measurements are recorded in the vendor comparison guide.

splitter.summary: The stem and both output arms were driven independently. Total collected guided power includes exactly the monitored channels.
splitter.limits: Fundamental quasi-TE mode at each port. Radiation and higher modes are excluded from the reported guided power sum. Material-grid differences affect weak reflection, phase and arm symmetry.

comparisons.description: The published optimized Y splits the transmitted power approximately in half. Compare arm imbalance separately from insertion loss.
The published thirteen-width junction reports <0.2 dB mean excess loss over 1.50–1.60 µm. Our cosine branch has a different shape.
The published-width sine-path model at 24 cells/µm measures 0.158 dB at 1.55 µm, versus 0.132 dB read from the plot. The notebook uses a different bend construction.
Using the regenerated notebook contour at 20 cells/µm gives 0.163 dB at 1.55 µm. The digitized value is 0.132 dB.

multimode.summary: Two modes enter independently from each side of an offset joint. The reference planes include the straight access lengths.
multimode.limits: The matrix includes two co-polarized guided modes per side. Radiation is unobserved. The planar study also has an independent transverse open-boundary mode-matching solution.

comparisons.description: The vendor EME method matches tangential fields between sections. Published slab-mode values are separate checks; there is no matched Lumerical matrix for this offset.
Local Tidy3D port modes use our exact cross sections. The published EME tutorial demonstrates modal coupling in a different device.

multimode-3d.summary: Two modes enter independently from each side of an offset joint. The reference planes include the straight access lengths.
multimode-3d.limits: The matrix includes two co-polarized guided modes per side. Radiation is unobserved. The planar study also has an independent transverse open-boundary mode-matching solution.

comparisons.description: The vendor EME method matches tangential fields between sections. Published slab-mode values are separate checks; there is no matched Lumerical matrix for this offset.
Local Tidy3D port modes use our exact cross sections. The published EME tutorial demonstrates modal coupling in a different device.

ring.dimension: Planar bus-loaded Hz spectra with a symmetric vertical slab index fixed at 1.55 µm. Separate finite-height cylindrical 3D Maxwell bare-ring poles and straight-strip MPB group delay.

comparisons.description: Measured planar free spectral range 40.250 nm; related vendor example 25.455 nm.
Measured planar free spectral range 23.500 nm; related vendor example 17.740 nm.

ring.summary: Inspect independently calibrated spectra for both published reference geometries.
ring.limits: A finite-height isolated ring check excludes the bus waveguides. A full loaded 3D spectrum requires a separate calculation.

grating.dimension: 2D x-z cross section, invariant lateral width; TE electric field perpendicular to the cross section

comparisons.description: Measured Gaussian-to-guide power 49.99%; vendor example 56.23%. Published best 2D period/beam position, layer boundaries and indices matched. Beam normalization and domain placement differ.

Measured Gaussian-to-guide power 49.42%; vendor example 55.70%. Article-based 100-tooth reconstruction at the published optimum angle. Oxide index, vectorial thin-lens focus, beam position and actual waist differ. The separate project-source control uses the index, waist and position from the downloadable FSP.
Matching the compact collection domain gives 58.23% at 1.55 µm. Tidy3D reports 56.23%.
The 60-cell source-matched model measures 55.62% at 1310 nm versus 55.7%. Its seven-point mean absolute difference is 9.39 percentage points. The filed output aperture is a separate observable.
At the filed 1 µm aperture, the 60-cell calculation measures 50.86% total flux at 1310 nm, compared with 55.7% published. TE0 at this plane is 48.12%.

grating.summary: Inspect independently calibrated spectra for both published reference geometries.
grating.limits: Upward radiated power and power coupled to a particular Gaussian mode have different collection and normalization.
